executive_summary: On August 5, 2026, OFAC removed three entities from the SDN list, including Fly Baghdad Airlines Company and two aircraft, YI-BAF and YI-BAN, all previously designated under the SDGT program. No new additions or updates were made. This removal may indicate a shift in sanctions policy towards Iraq.

notable_entities.significance: Removal of a previously designated entity under the SDGT program, potentially indicating a change in sanctions policy towards Iraq

risk_implications.description: The removal of these entities may reduce the risk of inadvertently conducting business with sanctioned parties in Iraq

compliance_recommendations: Review and update internal watchlists to reflect the removal of Fly Baghdad Airlines Company and the two aircraft, YI-BAF and YI-BAN, from the SDN list
Ensure due diligence procedures are in place to identify and prevent transactions with previously sanctioned entities
